card.title: 17th RIFLE REGIMENT
card.text: At the start of your turn, fully repair this unit and give it +1+1.
card.flavorText: The 17th Rifle Regiment served with the 32nd Rifle Division at the start of Operation Typhoon, the German strategic offensive of 1941 which marked the end of Operation Barbarossa and the beginning of the Red Army counteroffensive. The 32nd Rifle Division was transported to the Mozhaisk Defense Line, west of Moscow, where they set up defenses against the advancing German forces. The division had dug in on the Napoleonic battlefield of Borodino among other places west of Moscow, and the first battle took place in the Yelnya area where the 17th Rifle Regiment had set up defenses. The best the 32nd division could hope for was to slow down the two advancing German veteran divisions (10th Panzer Division and the 2nd SS Division Das Reich) which they managed to do for 5 days before Mozhaisk was lost. The heroic defense did not go unnoticed by Soviet officials and the 32nd Rifle Division was raised to guard status (29th Guards Rifle Division) and the 17th Rifle Regiment was awarded the Order of the Red Banner.
